components.description: The signature ginger cat as a clean geometric vector mark (crafted, not a doodle). Decorative: aria-hidden. Idle blink is disabled under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-mascot { display: inline-block; line-height: 0; filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 14px oklch(0.40 0.03 55 / 0.18)); } .ds-mascot .ds-mascot-eye { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: ds-blink 5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%, 92%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 96% { transform: scaleY(0.1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mascot .ds-mascot-eye { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: nirlep.dev is a warm little café that happens to love cats and code. You're welcomed in, handed something warm, and invited to stay a while: read a post, browse some work, watch the resident ginger cat stretch and blink at you from the corner. The personality is playful and witty with a soft, social warmth, and underneath it all is real craft. The whole system grows from one feline character: a signature ginger cat that watches the cursor, naps in empty states, and pads into 404s and loading moments. Warmth is carried by that character, by a burnt-ginger primary, by a deep warm-brown ink, and by friendly rounded type, never by a tinted 'cream' background. The reading surface is honest white so long posts and code stay crisp; the coziness lives in the brand colors, the soft corners, and the cat.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, light, and unmistakably feline: ginger leads, herb-green answers, on honest white.
One reactive mascot carries the personality; cat references are concentrated in the character, not sprinkled everywhere.
Soft corners, gentle warm shadows, generous rhythm. Friendly, never childish.
Charm never costs clarity: posts stay at 4.5:1+ contrast and 65-75ch line length.
Delight rewards the curious without gating the basics.

rules.name: The Honest-Wall Rule
rules.body: The page background is pure white (oklch(1 0 0)), never a warm-cream tint. Warmth is the cat's job, not the wall's. Cream, sand, parchment, beige body backgrounds are forbidden.

rules.name: The White-on-Warm Rule
rules.body: Text on any saturated ginger or herb fill is white, never dark; dark text is allowed only on the pale *-soft washes.

rules.name: The One Cat Rule
rules.body: Ginger is concentrated in the mascot and a small set of brand moments; it never blankets the screen.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tiny uppercase tracked kicker and no 01/02/03 markers above every section; sections lead with their Kreon headline.

rules.name: The Quiet-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for short labels and badges; body and headings are sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadow appears as feedback (hover, focus, float), then settles back.

rules.name: The One-Depth-Cue Rule
rules.body: An element uses a hairline border or a soft shadow, never a 1px border plus a wide drop-shadow together.

dos: Do keep the page background pure white and carry warmth through Ginger, Ink, soft shadows, rounded shapes, and the cat.
Do put white text on saturated ginger/herb fills; reserve dark text for the pale *-soft washes.
Do concentrate cat personality in the one mascot; let copy be cat-flavored but always clear.
Do cap body text at 65-75ch and keep all body/placeholder text at 4.5:1 or better.
Do use full-pill buttons, 14-18px card corners, and soft warm-brown shadows that appear on interaction.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback; the mascot rests, reveals become instant or crossfade.
donts: Don't rebuild the generic dark developer portfolio: near-black background, emerald/cyan neon glow, floating particles, or animated gradient hero text.
Don't ship a soulless SaaS template, hero-metric stat grids, or endless identical icon-cards.
Don't use childish clip-art: cheap cartoon-cat stickers, Comic Sans, or hand-drawn/feTurbulence doodle SVGs.
Don't slip into editorial-magazine costume: high-contrast Didone display, italic drop caps, ruled broadsheet columns.
Don't use a warm-cream/sand/beige body background, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide drop-shadow, round cards past 18px, or set display letter-spacing tighter than -0.04em.
